stepTitle: Train the model with regularization instead.
stepBody: Malavikha trains the following model without regularization:\n$$\hat{\text{attendance\_rate}} $$=$$ \hat{\theta}_0 + \hat{\theta}_1 $$\times$$ (\text{dist\_from\_bell})**{2} + \hat{\theta}_2 $$\times$$ \sqrt{\text{section\_no}}$$\nAfter applying bootstrapping to this model, Malavikha observed a high model bias squared. Evaluate whether the following suggestions can reduce model bias squared.
